generic_lessons: An original save-eligibility predicate can be true while the intended operation effect is not yet serialized. Measure eligibility and reload the actual saved world separately.
A timed test callback inside a command call stack is not proof that physical UI input or autosave can interleave at the same point. Preserve that scope limit.
A tiny typed function adapter can be adopted for diagnostic QA after real contracts while the wider recovery protocol remains unresolved.
Do not mistake a supplied engine getter call for absence of game logic; narrow candidate prose to its actual dependency and side effects.
Recheck relevant transparency contracts when modifying a call-through observer, and count inherited scenarios separately from new ones.
A camera navigation call returns before animation settles; inspect the raw final frame before publishing a claimed location.
scope_limit: One predicate-qualified precisely timed test save and two normal rounds after actual reload. Not physical UI/autosave reachability, engine input-queue guarantee, recovery fix, fullTC or Steam82 release.
